A KIDDO SCHOOL BOOK

Bunny Finds a Friend

A short picture story about a little bunny, a butterfly and a garden full of friends.

Age 2. Read together at your child’s pace — little hands can turn every page. Read online as often as you like.

Bunny Finds a Friend — the whole story

FOR GROWN-UPS

Read together, not on a schedule.

This book has eight little pages and one big idea: a friendly bunny meets some garden friends. There are no scores, no timers and nothing to finish — the story moves only when your child is ready.

Let your child point, name, listen, or simply enjoy the pictures. The small questions on each page are invitations, never tests: answer them together, or ignore them completely and make up your own.

Back to the LibraryAge 2 classesGarden Bugs & Friends
A KIDDO SCHOOL BOOK

My First Colors

A little book of colorful discoveries — eight happy colors, a find-the-colors game and a rainbow cheer.

Age 2. Read together at your child’s pace — little hands can turn every page. Read online as often as you like.

My First Colors — the whole story

FOR GROWN-UPS

Read together, not on a schedule.

This little book walks through eight colors with smiling friends: a red apple, an orange flower, purple grapes, a pink flower, a brown teddy bear, a yellow sun, a blue butterfly and a green leaf — then a find-the-colors challenge and a rainbow cheer end the book. There are no scores, no timers and nothing to finish — the pages turn only when your child is ready.

Let your child shout the color words, point at the pictures and hunt for each color around the room. The small questions on each page are invitations, never tests: answer them together, or ignore them completely and make up your own.
